lines.trans: I did not get out of my taxi all day, driving people.
Turn off the drill, I just lay down to sleep!
Listen, friend, we have another hour of work here.
Bear with us, tomorrow he picks up his wife from the hospital.
Please, put yourself in our shoes.

words.gloss: enter (войди в положение = put yourself in my position)

lines.trans: Is a baby going to be screaming in here too?
Yes, my child is going to live in my home.

words.gram: particle in the set phrase да ну

lines.trans: Do you have some kind of problem with that?
You will have problems if I hear the drill again!
Actually today is Saturday, you have no right.

lines.trans: Pay no attention to him, let's continue.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: А ну-ка, дай посмотрю! Внимание, ребята!
examples.trans: Hold on, let me have a look! Attention, everyone!

возить.gloss: to carry, to haul, to drive (regularly)

meanings.en: to transport, to haul, to bring (repeatedly, by vehicle)

examples.text: Без него вы бы возили сувениры из Китая.
examples.trans: Without him you would be hauling souvenirs from China.
He drives the children to school.

examples.text: Мы возим её сюда специальными боингами.
examples.trans: We fly it here on special Boeings.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

meanings.en: actually, as a matter of fact, for the record

examples.text: Меня вообще-то Юля зовут. Вот сахар.
examples.trans: My name is actually Yulia. Here's the sugar.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

вылезать.gloss: to climb out, to get out

meanings.en: to climb out, to get out

examples.trans: Get out of the car quickly, terrorist.

examples.text: Я сутки из такси не вылезал, людей возил.
examples.trans: I didn't get out of the taxi for a whole day, I was driving people around.

вырубить.gloss: to switch off (colloq.); to cut down

meanings.en: to switch off, to kill (power, a device)

examples.text: Вырубите дрель, я только спать лёг!
examples.trans: Turn off the drill, I just lay down to sleep!

examples.text: Кто-то вырубил свет во всём доме.
examples.trans: Somebody cut the power in the whole building.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.trans: There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: Квартира будет отличная. На Симашко есть новый дом.
examples.trans: It'll be an excellent flat. There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: Вырубите дрель, я только спать лёг!
examples.trans: Turn off the drill, I just lay down to sleep!

examples.text: Проблемы у тебя будут, если дрель услышу!
examples.trans: You will have problems if I hear the drill again!
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
I'm with my wife this evening.

examples.text: Но вечером я обещал быть с женой.
examples.trans: But I promised to be with my wife this evening.
I live in a communal flat.

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

related.gloss: to get on, for life to go (impersonal)

meanings.note: забирать деньги = to take the money
забирать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school

examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.

examples.text: А я тебе делаю условный срок. Плюс ты забираешь все деньги Вики.
examples.trans: And I get you a suspended sentence. Plus you take all of Vika's money.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.

examples.text: Нина, имей совесть! Я вчера ради вас всё сделал.
examples.trans: Nina, have a heart! Yesterday I did everything for you.

meanings.note: declines like какой: какая-то, какое-то, какие-то

examples.text: Бред какой-то. Но, с другой стороны, чем я рискую?
examples.trans: What nonsense. But on the other hand, what have I got to lose?

meanings.en: to lie down, go to bed
meanings.note: лягу спать = I will lie down to sleep

examples.text: Он лёг на диван и уснул.
examples.trans: He lay down on the sofa and fell asleep.
Alright, mommy. I will lie down quickly.

meanings.note: Как мужик = like a real man.

examples.trans: You should have acted like a real man!

examples.text: Что мы, мы? Тебе надо было как мужик!
examples.trans: What do you mean, we? You should have acted like a man!

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Не обращай внимания на его громкие шутки.
examples.trans: Do not pay attention to his loud jokes.

examples.text: Шеф всегда обращает внимание на каждую мелочь на тарелке.
examples.trans: The chef always pays attention to every little detail on the plate.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
to yell, to shout loudly, to bellow

examples.text: О, это, Аркашенька, бывает очень часто. Песни орём!
examples.trans: Oh, that happens very often, Arkashenka. Bellowing songs!

meanings.note: войти в положение = to put oneself in someone's shoes

examples.trans: He is in a difficult situation.

examples.text: Милая моя, войди в моё положение! Помоги мне, ты слышишь?
examples.trans: My darling, put yourself in my position! Help me, do you hear?

потерпеть.gloss: to be patient for a while, to endure

meanings.en: to be patient for a little while, to hold on

examples.text: Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: We need to be patient a little and work a bit.
Hang on for five more minutes.

examples.text: Послушай меня, Ваня. Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: Listen to me, Vanya. We need to be patient a little and work a bit.
She had a right to the flat.

examples.text: Моя мама имела право на квартиру. Она пенсионерка.
examples.trans: My mother had a right to the flat. She is a pensioner.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Так, операцию продолжаем. Михаил Михайлович, помогайте Лаврову.
examples.trans: Right, the operation goes on. Mikhail Mikhailovich, give Lavrov your help.

examples.text: В моём районе есть один неплохой роддом.
examples.trans: There's a pretty good maternity hospital in my neighbourhood.
She's being discharged from the maternity hospital tomorrow.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.note: имей совесть! = have a heart! / shame on you!

examples.text: Нина, имей совесть! Я вчера ради вас всё сделал.
examples.trans: Nina, have a heart! Yesterday I did everything for you.

examples.text: Ладно, утром позвоню ей. Поехали спать.
examples.trans: All right, I'll call her in the morning. Let's go to sleep.

examples.text: Скажи всем, что в субботу будет вечеринка.
examples.trans: Tell everyone that on Saturday there will be a party.

examples.text: Скажи всем ребятам, что в субботу вечером будет вечеринка.
examples.trans: Tell all the guys that on Saturday evening there will be a party.

examples.text: Каждую субботу в нашем ресторане бронируют абсолютно все столики.
examples.trans: Every Saturday absolutely all the tables in our restaurant are booked.

meanings.en: twenty-four-hour period, full day and night
meanings.note: plural-only noun; used with collective numerals like двое суток

examples.trans: We haven't slept for two days.
The train takes exactly forty-eight hours.

examples.text: Так точно, товарищ генерал! Мы вторые сутки не спим.
examples.trans: Yes, sir, Comrade General! We haven't slept for two days.

examples.text: Ты точно в порядке, может, вызвать такси?
examples.trans: Are you definitely alright, maybe call a taxi?
The taxi already drove up to the house.
We called a cab to the station.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: to hear, catch the sound of

examples.trans: I am glad to hear that.
I just want to hear the truth.

час.governs: after 2, 3, 4 and полтора the genitive часа is stressed on the ending

meanings.note: В два часа = at two o'clock.
В два часа = at two o'clock.

examples.trans: I'll be there in an hour.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
